budget_definition: one verifier call is one candidate passed once through scorer-v9; internal sandbox/harness subprocesses are implementation details

tasks.prompt: Design an inverting amplifier from Vin to Vout with 19-21 dB gain magnitude and 0.25-2.0 MHz bandwidth. Use real input and feedback impedances around a finite-bandwidth amplifier; the signed transfer must be negative.

fixed_template.netlist_template:
* Parameterized inverting amplifier
.param RinValue=$rin GainRatio=$gain
Vin vin 0 DC 0 AC 1
Vref nplus 0 DC 0
Rin vin nminus {RinValue}
Rf vout nminus {GainRatio*RinValue}
Rload vout 0 100k
Xop nplus nminus vout finite_opamp
.subckt finite_opamp inp inn out
Eerr raw 0 inp inn 100k
Rdom raw pole 1k
Cdom pole 0 $cdom
Ebuf out 0 pole 0 1
.ends finite_opamp
.op
.end

tasks.prompt: Design a non-inverting amplifier from Vin to Vout with 19-21 dB gain and 0.25-2.0 MHz bandwidth. Vin must drive the non-inverting signal path and output-derived feedback must set the closed-loop gain.

fixed_template.netlist_template:
* Parameterized non-inverting amplifier
.param RgValue=$rg FeedbackRatio=$ratio
Vin vin 0 DC 0 AC 1
Rg nminus 0 {RgValue}
Rf vout nminus {FeedbackRatio*RgValue}
Rload vout 0 100k
Xop vin nminus vout finite_opamp
.subckt finite_opamp inp inn out
Eerr raw 0 inp inn 100k
Rdom raw pole 1k
Cdom pole 0 $cdom
Ebuf out 0 pole 0 1
.ends finite_opamp
.op
.end

tasks.prompt: Design a unity-gain Sallen-Key low-pass filter from Vin to Vout with 9-11 kHz cutoff, -0.5 to 0.5 dB DC gain, and Q between 0.25 and 0.8. Both capacitors and the active stage must be load-bearing.
Design a matched BJT differential pair with Vp and Vn inputs and single-ended Vout. Meet 20-30 dB differential gain, 50-120 dB CMRR, 0.4-0.6 mA tail current, and 0-20 mV input offset.

fixed_template.netlist_template:
* Parameterized BJT differential pair
Vp vp 0 DC 0 AC 1
Vn vn 0 DC 0 AC 0
VCC vcc 0 DC 5
VEE vee 0 DC -5
Q1 vout vp emit QNPN
Q2 vc2 vn emit QNPN
RC1 vcc vout $rc
RC2 vcc vc2 $rc
Itail emit vee DC $itail
Rload vout 0 100k
.model QNPN NPN (IS=1e-15 BF=180 VAF=90 IKF=0.08 CJE=1.8p CJC=0.65p TF=45p TR=8n RB=80 RC=18 RE=1.5)
.op
.end
